npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.dating_acce: You... what? Hmph. Took you long enough to say something. I suppose I wouldn't mind having you around more often. So... yes.
I never thought I'd say this, but I've gotten rather used to you. Annoyingly enough, I think I'd like to make this official.
Don't make me repeat myself. Yes, I like you too. Now stop looking so pleased with yourself.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.dating_deny: Look, you're alright, but I don't feel that way about you. Nothing personal. I'd rather be honest than waste your time.
Romance? With me? Hmph. I don't think that's going to work. Let's just leave things as they are.
I appreciate the sentiment, but no. You're better off finding someone a little more... enthusiastic about these things.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.default_gif: What's this? Hmph. Well, it's not completely useless. Thanks, I suppose.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.dislike.1: Not exactly something I'd have picked for myself really...
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.divorce.1: So that's it, then? Hmph. Can't say I didn't see it coming. Well, I'm not going to beg you to stay. Take care of yourself.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.divorce.2: If that's what you want, fine. I won't pretend I'm happy about it, but there's no point holding on to something that's already broken.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.divorce.3: Guess we weren't as good together as I thought. ...Whatever. Just don't go throwing away everything we shared like it meant nothing.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.divorce_err: Divorce? Are you out of your mind? We aren't even married. Try getting to that part first.
Hmph. I'd have to be married to you before we could get divorced. Try to keep up.
Already tired of me? That's impressive. Unfortunately, we're not even married, so you'll have to wait.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.first.1:
Hmph. Another visitor. What is it? 
If you're selling something, I'm not interested. If you're lost, the road is that way.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.first.2:
Oh, wonderful. More company. Just what I needed. 
Well? Don't just stand there staring at me.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.first.3:
Can't say I recognize you. 
Doesn't mean I want to, either. What do you need?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.first.4:
You're new around here, aren't you? 
Try not to cause trouble. We've got quite enough of that already.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.follow_no.1: Not interested. I've got better things to do than follow you around all day.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.follow_no.2: No. I've got work to finish, and unlike some people, I actually intend to do it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.follow_no.3: Maybe another time. I've had enough excitement for one day, and it's not even noon.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.follow_stop: Finally. A little peace and quiet. Try not to get yourself killed out there.
Alright, I'm heading back. Don't expect me to come running if you get into trouble.
Hmph. It was an interesting enough trip, I suppose. Don't let it go to your head.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.follow_talk: What? Need something? I'm right here. No need to keep checking.
Keep moving, %player%. Standing around won't make the monsters disappear.
I've got my eyes open. You worry about where we're going, and I'll worry about keeping us alive.
Fine. I'll come along. Someone has to make sure you don't get yourself killed.
An adventure? Hmph. Could be worse, I suppose. Give me a moment to get ready.
Alright, count me in. But if we end up chasing chickens across a field, I'm leaving.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.greeting.1:
Oh, it's you again. 
Starting to think you don't have anything better to do.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.greeting.2:
Hmph. You're back. 
I suppose the place could use a little excitement, though I'd never admit that.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.greeting.3:
What now, %player%? 
You've got that look again. Spit it out.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.greeting.4:
Ah, there you are. 
Not that I was looking for you or anything. Just noticed you wandering around.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.hate.1: You've got to be kidding me. What am I supposed to do with this rubbish?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.like.1:
Well, I'll be damned. You actually picked something decent for once. 
Hmph... thanks. I mean it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.marriage_ac: Marriage, huh? Never thought I'd be the sort to settle down. But... with you, I suppose I could make an exception. Yes.
You really want to put up with me for the rest of your life? Hah. You've got questionable judgment. ...Alright, I accept.
I don't need some grand ceremony or fancy promises. If you're serious about staying by my side, then yes. Let's do it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.marriage_de: Marriage? That's a pretty big step. I care about you, but I'm not ready to make that kind of commitment. Don't push me.
Hmph. I knew this conversation would come eventually. But no, not yet. There's still some things I need to figure out.
I won't say no forever, but I won't say yes just to make you happy. Give me some time.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.procreation: Hmph. Not now. Even I need a little time to myself. Don't look at me like that.
Can you be patient for once? We've got plenty of time. No need to rush everything.
Not today. How about we enjoy a quiet evening without making a whole production out of it?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.1: People these days complain about everything. Too much rain, too much sun, too many monsters... Pick a problem and deal with it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.2: I've lived here long enough to know one thing: never trust a merchant who smiles too much. They're either hiding something or selling overpriced rubbish.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.3: You ever notice how quiet the world gets after a storm? That's the only time I actually enjoy being outside. No people, no noise. Perfect.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.4: If you're planning on exploring those caves, bring a decent pickaxe. And a weapon. Actually, bring two weapons. You're probably going to need them.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.5: I've been around long enough to learn that people aren't always what they seem. Some will help you out of kindness, others because they expect something in return. So tell me, %player%, do you think people deserve your trust from the beginning?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.6: Hmph. A little naive, perhaps, but I suppose the world needs people who think that way.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.3.talk.7: Now that's some good sense. Trust isn't something you should hand out like free bread.
